name: Annotations Workflows
description: Attaches a content-moderation workflow to annotation types so annotations move through editorial states.
project_description: Annotations Workflows attaches a content-moderation workflow to the annotation entity so annotations can move through editorial states (draft/published). It ships a workflows.workflow.annotations config, adds every annotation type to that workflow on install and via hook_annotation_type_insert, and removes types on deletion. With a workflow attached, annotation publish status follows the moderation state; consumer contexts (overlay, context, reports) show only published annotations. Requires annotations, annotations_ui, content_moderation, and workflows.
